---
title: "Planktothrix Stacked Bar Chart"
output: pdf_document
date: "2025-02-06"
---

Create stacked taxa bar chart showing relative abundance in each culture
read in .txt file from omics box
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

# Load libraries
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggsci)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(vegan)

# Read file
taxo <- read.table("D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/kraken/gtdbtk/taxonomic_classification.txt", sep = "\t", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

```

Filter for genus level only
```{r}
taxo_genus <- taxo[taxo$Rank %in% c("genus"), ]
```


Calculate percentages
```{r}

taxo_data <- taxo_genus[, -c(1, 2, 3)]  # Remove the Rank, TaxId, and Scientific Name columns (adjust column indexes if necessary)

# Calculate column sums (total abundance per sample)
col_sums <- colSums(taxo_data)

# Calculate percentage relative to each sample (i.e., normalize columns)
taxo_percentage <- sweep(taxo_data, 2, col_sums, FUN = "/") * 100


```

Apply 1% threshold 
```{r}
# Make a separate copy for the stacked bar chart
# Keep taxo_percentage unchanged so it retains the TRUE relative abundances
taxo_percentage_stacked <- taxo_percentage

# Identify values < 1%
low_abundance_mask <- taxo_percentage_stacked < 1

# Calculate "Other" row
other_row <- colSums(
  taxo_percentage_stacked * low_abundance_mask,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Set <1% values to zero ONLY in the stacked-bar copy
taxo_percentage_stacked[low_abundance_mask] <- 0

# Filter out genera that are <1% in every sample
keep_rows <- rowSums(taxo_percentage_stacked) > 0

taxo_percentage_filtered <-
  taxo_percentage_stacked[keep_rows, ]

taxo_metadata_filtered <- taxo_genus[keep_rows, c(1, 2, 3)]

# Add metadata back to filtered data
taxo_filtered <- cbind(taxo_metadata_filtered, taxo_percentage_filtered)

# Build the "Other" row
other_row_df <- data.frame(
  Rank = "genus",
  TaxId = NA,
  Scientific.Name = "Other",
  t(other_row)
)
colnames(other_row_df) <- colnames(taxo_filtered)

# Combine with "Other"
taxo_filtered <- rbind(taxo_filtered, other_row_df)


```


Reshape data for plotting
```{r}
# Reshape the data to long format
taxo_long <- pivot_longer(taxo_filtered, cols = starts_with("Trim"), names_to = "Sample", values_to = "Abundance")

# Remove rows where abundance is NA (below the 1% threshold)
taxo_long <- taxo_long[!is.na(taxo_long$Abundance), ]

# Rename samples since they still have trimmed read titles
taxo_long <- taxo_long %>%
  mutate(Sample = dplyr::recode(Sample,
    "Trim135115_CCACAACA.GTACCACA_S55" = "1810",
    "Trim135108_CGGCATTA.GTCAGTCA_S48" = "1031",
    "Trim135109_CACGCAAT.CCTTCCAT_S49" = "1033",
    "Trim135110_GGAATGTC.AGGAACAC_S50" = "1809",
    "Trim135112_GGACATCA.TACCTGCA_S52" = "1025",
    "Trim135113_GGTGTACA.AGACGCTA_S53" = "1027",
    "Trim135114_GATAGCCA.CAACACAG_S54" = "1808",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4" = "1026",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1029" = "1029",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1030" = "1030",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1032" = "1032",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1801" = "1801",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1802" = "1802",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1803" = "1803",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1804" = "1804",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1805" = "1805",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1806" = "1806",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1807" = "1807",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1811" = "1811",
    "TrimHH3VGDSXY_s4_1812" = "1812"
  ))

taxo_long <- taxo_long %>%
  mutate(Scientific.Name = recode(Scientific.Name,
                                  "Kinneretia" = "JACDQM01 (Kinneretia)"))

```

Create stacked bar chart
```{r}

# Calculate overall genus abundance


# This determines the legend order.
# Genera are ranked by their total abundance across all samples.
# "Other" will be placed last regardless of abundance.

genus_abundance <- taxo_long %>%
  group_by(Scientific.Name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_abundance = sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Scientific.Name == "Other",
    desc(total_abundance)
  )



# Set legend order

genus_order <- genus_abundance %>%
  filter(
    as.character(Scientific.Name) != "Other"
  ) %>%
  pull(Scientific.Name) %>%
  as.character()

genus_order <- c(
  genus_order,
  "Other"
)

taxo_long <- taxo_long %>%
  mutate(
    Scientific.Name = factor(
      as.character(Scientific.Name),
      levels = genus_order
    )
  )


# Set sample order

sample_order <- c(
  "1025", "1026", "1027", "1029", "1030",
  "1031", "1032", "1033",
  "1801", "1802", "1803", "1804", "1805",
  "1806", "1807", "1808", "1809", "1810",
  "1811", "1812"
)

taxo_long <- taxo_long %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = factor(
      Sample,
      levels = sample_order
    )
  )



# Order genera independently within each sample

taxo_plot <- taxo_long %>%
  filter(
    Abundance > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  arrange(
    Scientific.Name == "Other",
    desc(Abundance),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = lag(
      cumsum(Abundance),
      default = 0
    ),
    xmax = cumsum(Abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()




# Create genus color palette

my_colors <- c(
  "#477FA3",
  "#C56F3D",
  "#C996AC",
  "#9A7135",
  "#779B45",
  "#C99A32",
  "#C75A82",
  "#626262",
  "#89665C",
  "#57935B",
  "#C97E7C",
  "#765A9B",
  "#A45132",
  "#3D929B",
  "#9A9A45",
  "#8A70A2",
  "#3F8F78",
  "#B66F9B",
  "#287D8E",
  "#B5A65D",
  "#5B5FAD",
  "#88A96F",
  "#9A8CAF",
  "#A9867D",
  "#7E9DB5",
  "#D07cdD"
)


# Identified genera only
identified_genera <- genus_order[
  genus_order != "Other"
]


# Make sure enough colors are available
stopifnot(
  length(my_colors) >=
    length(identified_genera)
)


# Assign colors according to overall abundance rank
genus_colors <- setNames(
  my_colors[
    seq_along(identified_genera)
  ],
  identified_genera
)


# Other is always neutral gray
genus_colors <- c(
  genus_colors,
  "Other" = "#D0D0D0"
)


# Create stacked bar chart

stacked_chart <- ggplot(
  taxo_plot,
  aes(
    xmin = xmin,
    xmax = xmax,
    ymin = as.numeric(Sample) - 0.425,
    ymax = as.numeric(Sample) + 0.425,
    fill = Scientific.Name
  )
) +
  geom_rect() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = genus_colors,
    breaks = genus_order,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(
      0,
      25,
      50,
      75,
      100
    ),
    expand = c(
      0,
      0
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq_along(sample_order),
    labels = sample_order,
    expand = expansion(
      add = 0.5
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(
      0,
      100
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Relative Abundance (%)",
    y = expression(
      italic("Planktothrix") ~
        "Isolate Designation"
    ),
    fill = "Genus"
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 4,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.size = unit(
      0.4,
      "cm"
    ),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(
      0.15,
      "cm"
    )
  )

stacked_chart





```



```{r}
# Save figure

ggsave(
  paste0(
    "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/",
    "bar_charts/stacked_bar_chart_gtdbtk.png"
  ),
  stacked_chart,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)
```



Create genus abundance boxplots across cultures
```{r}
# Start with the relative abundance data BEFORE the 1% filtering so that low-abundance observations are retained
genus_boxplot_data <- taxo_percentage %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Add genus names
genus_boxplot_data$Scientific.Name <- taxo_genus$Scientific.Name


# Read GTDB-Tk classification output
gtdb <- read.delim(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/gtdb_output/339MAGs/classify/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Extract genus and phylum from GTDB taxonomy
genus_phylum_lookup <- gtdb %>%
  select(classification) %>%
  separate(
    classification,
    into = c(
      "domain",
      "phylum",
      "class",
      "order",
      "family",
      "genus",
      "species"
    ),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum = str_remove(phylum, "^p__"),
    Scientific.Name = str_remove(genus, "^g__")
  ) %>%
  select(Scientific.Name, Phylum) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Scientific.Name),
    Scientific.Name != "",
    !is.na(Phylum),
    Phylum != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct()

# Assign phylum using GTDB taxonomy
genus_boxplot_data <- genus_boxplot_data %>%
  left_join(
    genus_phylum_lookup,
    by = "Scientific.Name",
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )

# Rename Kinneretia
genus_boxplot_data <- genus_boxplot_data %>%
  mutate(
    Scientific.Name = recode(
      Scientific.Name,
      "Kinneretia" = "JACDQM01 (Kinneretia)"
    )
  )

# Assign phylum to genera not matched in GTDB
genus_boxplot_data <- genus_boxplot_data %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum = case_when(
      Scientific.Name == "Unknown" ~ "Unclassified",
      Scientific.Name %in% c(
        "JACDQM01 (Kinneretia)",
        "Roseomonas_A",
        "Erythrobacter",
        "Nordella"
      ) & is.na(Phylum) ~ "Pseudomonadota",
      TRUE ~ Phylum
    )
  )

# Convert from wide format to long format
# Each row will now represent one genus in one culture/sample.
genus_boxplot_long <- genus_boxplot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Scientific.Name, Phylum),
    names_to = "Culture",
    values_to = "Abundance"
  )

# Determine which genera to display
# Keep genera whose MAXIMUM abundance across samples reaches at least 1%.
genera_to_plot <- genus_boxplot_long %>%
  group_by(Scientific.Name) %>%
  summarise(
    Max_Abundance = max(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(Max_Abundance >= 1) %>%
  pull(Scientific.Name)

genus_boxplot_long <- genus_boxplot_long %>%
  filter(Scientific.Name %in% genera_to_plot)

# Order genera by median abundance
genus_order <- genus_boxplot_long %>%
  group_by(Scientific.Name) %>%
  summarise(Median_Abundance = median(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Median_Abundance)) %>%
  pull(Scientific.Name)

genus_boxplot_long$Scientific.Name <- factor(
  genus_boxplot_long$Scientific.Name,
  levels = genus_order
)

# Create boxplot with individual samples shown as points
boxplot <- ggplot(
  genus_boxplot_long,
  aes(
    x = Scientific.Name,
    y = Abundance,
    fill = Phylum
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genus",
    y = "Relative Abundance (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
    "Actinomycetota"  = "#7c6f64",
    "Bacteroidota"    = "#5b7694",
    "Cyanobacteriota" = "#52796f",
    "Pseudomonadota"  = "#b45f5a",
    "Chloroflexota"   = "#C49A56"
    
    )
  )

boxplot
```



```{r}
# Save figure
ggsave(
  "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/bar_charts/genus_abundance_boxplot.png",
  boxplot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600
)
```

combined_figure <- combined_figure +

  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(
        size = 14,
        face = "bold"
      )
    )
  )

combined_figure
